name: Data Analytics and Decision Making, Undergraduate Certificate

requirements.label: Elective Courses
notes: Choose six credits from the following:

items.label: Elective Courses
items.text: Complete 6 credits of electives from list

BIOL 3100.title: Introduction to Data Analysis for Biologists

CS 1400.title: Fundamentals of Programming
CS 1400.prereqText: Math at least equivalent to high school algebra and trigonometry. CS 1030 recommended.

CS 1410.title: Object Oriented Programming
CS 1410.prereqText: CS 1400 and Math equivalent to at least college algebra

CS 2420.title: Introduction to Algorithms and Data Structures

INFO 1200.title: Computer Programming I for IS IT
INFO 1200.prereqText: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 recommended; INFO 1120 recommended

INFO 3130.title: Introduction to Applied Data Analytics
INFO 3130.prereqText: Basic statistics course ( MGMT 2340 or STAT 1040 or STAT 1045 or STAT 2040 or STAT 2050 or PSY 3110 ), and basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, or Departmental Approval and University Advanced Standing

INFO 4130.title: Data Science and Big Data Analytics

MATH 1050.title: College Algebra
MATH 1050.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1100.title: Survey of Calculus
MATH 1100.prereqText: Within the past two years: MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 or MATH 1080 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MGMT 2340.title: Business Statistics I
MGMT 2340.prereqText: MATH 1050 , MATH 1055 , or MATH 1090 or higher, or appropriate test scores

PSY 3110.title: Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences
PSY 3110.prereqText: MAT 1010 or higher and University Advanced Standing

STAT 2040.title: Principles of Statistics
STAT 2040.prereqText: Within the past two years, MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 or MATH 1080 with a grade of C or higher or appropriate math placement test score.

STAT 2050.title: Introduction to Statistical Methods
STAT 2050.prereqText: Within the past two years, MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 or MATH 1080 with a grade of C or higher or appropriate math placement test score.
